name: away-schedule-restarts
description: Same plant and stretch as away-short-plant-short-stretch: the watering the stretch pushed to 11-16 moves the whole schedule, so the next one is a full interval later (11-20), not back on the original grid (11-18).
why: , Reading: the plan should move the whole interval after an away stretch and regroup from there, not complain and snap back.
